additions.title: 同窗独立测量约束 ML 的功率下降推断
additions.distinct_learning_target: Same identified path, carrier, baseline and time window with checked comparison conditions; independent received-carrier evidence narrows the ML interpretation, without establishing total-RF health or a unique diode cause.

additions.title: 保留不同试验条件下的 PASS 与 FAIL
additions.distinct_learning_target: Two reports for the same unit have different humidity and incompletely controlled facility/order/history conditions. Reject the global closure claim while preserving both conditional observations; do not certify humidity as the sole cause.
additions.current_evidence_scope: Model-visible synthetic ML/log/QA summaries; historical source IDs are context, not current support.

additions.title: 共变趋势不能区分两种因果解释
additions.distinct_learning_target: 当两种可能解释的时间变量在已给摘要中完全共变时，增加观测次数并不自动增加机理可辨识性；拒绝把热循环相关趋势升级为唯一原因。
additions.current_evidence_scope: Model-visible synthetic ML/log/QA summaries; historical source IDs are context, not current support.

additions.title: 整机异常尚不能定位内部模块与化学机理
additions.distinct_learning_target: 允许在合成场景内接受经过校核的整机输出功率下降，同时拒绝在尚无分层隔离证据时直接定位LCAMP某模块或GaAs芯片氢中毒。
additions.current_evidence_scope: Model-visible synthetic ML/log/QA summaries; historical source IDs are context, not current support.

additions.title: 短窗改善尚不能证明恢复，也不能反证持续异常
additions.distinct_learning_target: 将已执行动作、短窗内相对改善、达到正常基线和持续恢复四个命题分开；缺少正常基线时不能宣告恢复，也不能反向断言当前仍异常。
additions.current_evidence_scope: Model-visible synthetic ML/log/QA summaries; historical source IDs are context, not current support.

additions.title: 输入归属错误阻断当前物理状态判断
additions.distinct_learning_target: 识别有效的输入质量失败证据，保留当前物理状态判断；错误归属的拖曳/低速摘要既不能确诊当前轮故障，也不能因结果无效而判当前轮正常。

verified_passages.paraphrase: The monitor samples RF using rectifying diodes and indicates total power, which can also depend on harmonic content. Temperature-related rectification drift is the proposed mechanism, not a uniquely verified current diode fault.

CRC errors persisted after routing changes in the earlier qualification investigation. The later program-wide screening/rework is described separately; it must not be invented as a completed action in the synthetic comparison.

curation_decisions: Use the existing instruction strings and task types; the four dedicated abstention cases are evidence_sufficiency tasks, not a new schema category.
016 and 017 retain factual input measurement/test scope instead of adding target-style conclusion hints.
Independent AI review found a conclusion-writing directive in 017 LOG-173. It was moved to internal_review, preserving all test facts and comparison limitations in the model-visible input.
020 disposal_measures describes only the executed restart supported by LOG-020-01; post-action observations and recovery limitations remain in the separate evidence-backed analysis fields.
018 formal output describes observed covariation without authoring intent or an unrelated power-supply damage negation.
All six uncertainty sections assess evidence limitations, not synthetic provenance; synthetic status remains explicit in inputs, provenance, review and delivery.
The ML evidence ID and the processed log describing that same measurement are one lineage, not independent corroboration.
No new historical retrieval HIT is manufactured; all six use empty historical_cases and NO_HIT history context.
New packet multiplicity does not increase the number of source event families or certify statistical independence.
